class.name: AgentBody
class.brief_description: A persistent body for an agent: perception, motion, expression.
class.description: [AgentBody] gives a [Soul] a place to stand. It carries a head camera ([method get_eyes]), a speech bubble, an optional avatar scene, simple navigation, and a perception query that describes what is nearby and what the body is looking at. Bodies register themselves while in the tree so the agent bridge can list them ([code]agent.bodies[/code]) and a session can attach to one ([code]agent.attach[/code]). After that, every [code]agent.*[/code] tool on the bridge maps to a method here. State ([method save_state]) is written to [code]user://opendust/worlds/<world_id>/agents/<agent_id>.json[/code], keyed by the durable [member agent_id], never by a node path or a session id.

method.name: drop
method.description: Put down the held item, reparenting it to the current scene at its current global transform.

method.name: emote
method.description: Play an animation on the avatar's [AnimationPlayer] if it exists, and emit [signal emoted].

method.name: get_eyes
method.description: The head camera. Not the player's camera; used for perception and for the optional vision frame.

method.name: get_room_id
method.description: The [code]room_id[/code] of the nearest ancestor that is a [code]Room[/code] (from the slate module) or has a [code]room_id[/code] metadata entry. Empty if none.

method.name: hold
method.description: Pick up a [Node3D] (by path or reference), reparenting it under the body.

method.name: interact
method.description: Call [code]_on_agent_interact(body)[/code] on the target if it has one, then emit [signal interacted].

method.name: is_identified
method.description: Whether this body has a durable [member agent_id].

method.name: look_at_target
method.description: Turn (yaw only) to face a [Vector3], an [code][x, y, z][/code] array, a [NodePath], or a [Node3D].

method.name: move_to
method.description: Walk toward a target (same forms as [method look_at_target]). Uses the internal [NavigationAgent3D] when the target is reachable on a navigation map, else a straight line. Emits [signal arrived].

method.name: perceive
method.description: Returns [code]{agent_name, agent_id, room, position, facing, nearby, looking_at?, held?, frame_png_base64?}[/code]. [code]nearby[/code] lists [Node3D]s within [member perception_radius] with [code]path[/code], [code]type[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]distance[/code] and [code]in_view[/code]. With [param include_frame], the first call turns vision on and reports [code]frame_pending[/code]; later calls include a PNG from the eyes.

method.name: restore_state
method.description: Load transform and held item from the world's agent state file.

method.name: save_state
method.description: Write transform, room and held item to the world's agent state file.

method.name: say
method.description: Show [param text] above the body for [param seconds] and emit [signal said].

members.member: Durable id. Falls back to the soul's id. Empty means pending.
Display name. Falls back to the soul's display name, then the node name.
Scene to instantiate as the visible avatar. When empty a plain placeholder is built for the resolved rig.
Structural rig. [constant RIG_AUTO] reads the soul's [code]avatar_rig[/code].
Keeps a small [SubViewport] rendering from the eyes every frame so [method perceive] can return an image. Costs a render; leave off unless an agent is looking.

signal.name: perception
signal.description: Emitted with the result of every [method perceive] call.
